news.title: Writing across disciplines: UI is in elite company
news.summary_en: Iowa’s unmatched writing-related resources prepare its graduates for success in many fields. This level of excellence, strengthened in the past year by the creation of the Office of Writing and Communication and piloting a new undergraduate curriculum, positions Iowa as the best public university for writing and communication.

news.title: Fall cohort brings new vision to UI’s International Writing Program
news.summary_en: Nearly 60 years after its founding, the International Writing Program begins another chapter supported by donors, longtime partners, and the Iowa City community. This fall’s cohort of 22 residents will help guide the program’s future and continue its tradition of bringing writers together across borders.
